N° 11AI setup service for small businesses2026

Zeste

Your business finally has a guardian.

Visit Zeste, the service page →How to use itWatch the purpose

I

Purpose

Put artificial intelligence to work in a small business without the owner having to learn it: messages, quotes, payment reminders, accounts, reviews. I set it up, I tune it, I watch over it.

II

The problem

Small business owners hear that AI will change everything and are left alone with a subscription they do not know how to use. Most guides are in English, written for offices, and silent about WhatsApp and mobile money.

III

What I built

A warm service page in French and English: a dusk village drawn in 3D, an office-work check of five questions that shows the first tasks I can set up, an explainer film of a minute and a half, eight task cards with examples in FCFA, a five step process, four clear prices with a currency switch, an AI analysis of the business, and a setup guide that unlocks only for clients.

IV

How it works

The check runs in the visitor's browser and nothing is sent. Every card can be read aloud. A generated soundtrack of kalimba and nature plays only when asked. The guide is encrypted in the page and opens with the code a client receives after the setup session.

V

Craft

Plum dusk, warm paper, a lemon mascot, handwritten examples from real trades.

VI

The purpose, in motion

A short motion design made for this book: four beats, one drawn shape each, the reason the project exists. Tap it to step through.

Zeste
VII

In short

  • An office-work check in one minute
  • An explainer film in two languages
  • Prices in FCFA and dollars
  • A client-only setup guide
